crossRefs.note: As for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah couldn’t drive them out; but the Jebusites…
Manasseh didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shean and its towns, nor Taanach and its towns, nor the inhabitants…
You shall make no covenant with the inhabitants of this land. You shall break down their altars.’ But you have not…
Therefore I also said, ‘I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be in your sides, and their gods will…
For you have forsaken your people, the house of Jacob, because they are filled from the east, with those who practice…
Your boasting is not good. Don’t you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump?
Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”
